description: **A retired or newly added project no longer leaves every other project's page listing the wrong tools.** The "More tools from this site" section each assembled page ends with was rendered once, when that project last deployed, and nothing refreshed it afterwards: a project joining the site reached nobody else's pages, and retiring one left its address linked from every other project's -- an address the site no longer serves, which made every following deploy fail verification. Every deploy now regenerates the section on every page in the tree.
